newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Astra mid-term cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Astra mid-term cut.

text.p: - Merrill Lynch said it downgraded its intermediate term rating on ASTRA Compania Argentina de Petroleo from a buy to accumulate.

- Vice President Frank McGann wrote in an investor bulletin that Astra's purchase of a 45 percent interest in Argentine energy company Pluspetrol, for $340 million, could cause near-term earnings dilution.
- The investment firm estimates the purchase could be dilutive by $0.01-$0.02 per share in 1997 and 1998. It is reducing its 1997 estimate by $0.01 per share from $0.14 per share to $0.13 per share.
- Merrill is not changing its long-term buy rating based on the expected positive effects on cash-flow and the long-term strategic benefits of the purchase.
